Name: 7B2's SDV Governor Portrait Replacer
Author: NexusUser7B2
Description:
As stated above this mod will replace the governor's portraits. Nothing more, nothing less.
Drew this from scratch and then commissioned for someone to greatly improve on what I did.
Tested ingame and it worked.
Enjoy!

If someone ever implements the governor as a full npc or whatever and wants to do seasonal variants with this as a base no need to ask for my permission.

Anything else just ask or go by the permissions in the permissions section.

Credits:
Me for the base portrait.
Crywolfe from kofi for greatly improving on what I had done. ( https://ko-fi.com/crywolfe )
